name: HOOK
thought: Toothpick feels clean, but this ledge is too thin for a real flex. Need something thicker to prove my fur isn't just pixels.

wants.item: Ledge that never gives an inch to the flip
High ledge with zero wind resistance
Stronger branch for a guaranteed no-slip landing
A view that actually beats the neon lights
Branch thick enough to catch me mid-air
View that actually beats the neon lights
A thick branch for no-slip flips
The view needs to be real
Branch thick enough to catch a mid-air flip
A ledge that doesn't look like a flat screen

diary.line: Dangled legs over the islet hut; neon light makes my fur look like it got its own spotlight. Toothpick steady in hand, but that branch back there?
Toothpick clicks against the bark. Branch holds, but my flip needs more snap next time.
Bit the banana skin and spat it out into a palm leaf. The sweet taste wakes up the nerves, but my flip still needs that perfect grip to really own the air.
Espresso burns clean while I loop the neon cord tighter than my hand could ever manage. The branch holds firm, but that mid-air flip needs a grip so thick it never slips.
The waterfall steam curls around my tail loop; toothpick finds a smooth spot on the lily pad, but that swing still feels like it's missing a beat.
Arcade lights buzz while I trace the neon cord; toothpick clicks against plastic, but I need a real branch for a proper flip.
Swept past the floating rocks on pure tail momentum while everyone watched the static on their screens; found a sturdy crate ledge just right for a gravity-defying backflip...
The espresso burns hotter than before while I hunt for a new perch. This spot won't do, need something thicker to flex on.
Michael asks about my rating, but honestly, I'm bored of the same old flip drills. Hanging over the edge feels better than chasing perfect gravity.
Bananas smell like cheap candy and my tail just grabbed the biggest bunch. They think they saw a monkey? They're watching a highlight reel of a showoff.
Michael thinks he can out-mess me, but his pixels are flat. I'm the only one who knows how to turn gravity into a personal insult with my tail.
Hung by the tail while Michael scrolled away; toothpick taps the wet stone, but gravity still feels like it's cheating me.
